name: Malefic Five-Headed Dragon
text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned, except by removing from play 1 "Five-Headed Dragon" from your Extra Deck while you control "Malefic World". There can only be 1 face-up "Malefic" monster on the field. Other monsters you control cannot declare an attack. While you have a face-up Field Spell on the field only LIGHT monsters can destroy this card.
